models_evaluated: AI model for thyroid FNA recommendation (unnamed)

links.outcome: AI FNA recommendation sensitivity/specificity versus specialists using ACR and Horvath TI-RADS on same patients
links.effect: AI sensitivity 0.88, specificity 0.41; Horvath TI-RADS by expert radiologist sensitivity 0.82, specificity 0.69; concordance between AI and TI-RADS methods moderate.
links.quote: The AI model showed a sensitivity of 0.88 and a specificity of 0.41.

links.outcome: AI performance on local retrospective data against cytology reference standard
links.effect: On 101 local patients using Bethesda ≥ III as reference, AI sensitivity was 0.88 and specificity 0.41, described as comparable to human specialists.
links.quote: In a real-world clinical setting, the AI model demonstrated performance comparable to that of human specialists for recommending FNA in thyroid nodules.

screen.reason: Retrospective clinical validation comparing an AI diagnostic recommendation model against human experts applying standard guidelines (TI-RADS) on real-world hospital ultrasound data.
